# cardos-mcp

> MCP server for CardOS — issue and manage virtual cards from any MCP client (Claude, Cursor, Windsurf, VS Code). A thin, safe client over the public CardOS REST API (https://cardos.dev/api/v1). Sandbox-first: a cms_sk_test_… key moves no real money.

## Setup
- Get an API key: https://cardos.dev/partner/developers
- Run: `CARDOS_API_KEY=cms_sk_test_xxx npx cardos-mcp`
- Config (Claude/Cursor/Windsurf/VS Code): command `npx`, args `["-y","cardos-mcp"]`, env `CARDOS_API_KEY`.

## Tools (26)
Catalog & balance: list_products, get_merchant_rates, get_balance.
Cards: issue_card, get_card, freeze_card, unfreeze_card, close_card, set_card_pin, set_card_controls, reveal_card, create_card_session, list_card_transactions.
Deposits: create_deposit, confirm_deposit_sandbox, simulate_transaction_sandbox.
Statements & analytics: get_statement, get_spending_analytics.
Disputes: file_dispute, list_disputes, get_dispute, update_dispute.
KYC: start_kyc, get_kyc_status.
Webhooks: register_webhook, list_webhooks.

## Resources
cardos://docs — auth, idempotency, webhooks orientation.
cardos://openapi — the full OpenAPI 3 spec.

## Prompts
issue_card_for_user, integrate_cardos.
